project_type: React + Vite SPA with Tailwind CSS and Firebase Firestore
test_framework: No test framework configured (no test files or test dependencies in package.json)
test_command: npm run build (no tests configured - build validation only)
verification_instructions: Run 'npm run build' to verify the project compiles without errors
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. Node.js 22 available via nvm.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Project uses single-file architecture (most logic in App.jsx, ~5300 lines).
key_patterns: 1) All state lives in App.jsx as useState hooks. 2) Firestore save is debounced (500ms in App, 2500ms in firestoreService) via saveTimerRef. 3) UI uses Tailwind classes with responsive prefixes (sm:, md:). 4) Icons from lucide-react. 5) Toolbar is a <header> at h-10 with flex items-center. 6) Undo/Redo buttons are in a right-aligned div with class 'relative flex items-center gap-0.5 sm:gap-1 shrink-0'. 7) The save flow: App state changes -> useEffect triggers -> debounced localStorage write + saveToFirestore call -> firestoreService has its own 2500ms debounce before actual Firestore write.
directory_structure: src/App.jsx - main component with all state and UI (~5300 lines), src/firestoreService.js - Firestore save/load with debounce, src/firebase.js - Firebase config, src/MiniMap.jsx - mini map component, src/TaskPanel.jsx - task panel component
